content.title: Add /status endpoint and E2E environment safety guard
content.description:
Add a backend /status endpoint and an E2E startup guard so E2E tests can never pollute the real development .agentrack/ folder.

Part A — GET /api/status endpoint:
- New route (e.g. server/routes/status.ts) registered in server/index.ts as app.route('/api/status', statusRoute).
- Response body: { agentrackPath: <AGENTRACK_CWD> } where the value is the resolved tracker cwd (process.env.AGENTRACK_CWD || process.cwd()). Reuse the cwd resolution already in server/utils/tracker.ts (consider exporting it from there or a shared config module so the route and the tracker stay in sync).
- Add the response type to server/types.ts.

Part B — E2E global-setup guard:
- In e2e/global-setup.ts (or setup.ts), after the Playwright webServers are up, fetch http://localhost:<E2E_API_PORT>/api/status and read agentrackPath. The E2E API port will be 5001 once the ports deliverable lands.
- If agentrackPath resolves to the project's real .agentrack/ directory (i.e. <projectRoot>/.agentrack), THROW / abort the test run immediately (fail fast in globalSetup) before any test creates issues or users.
- Otherwise (path is the isolated validation/.e2edata/) proceed normally.
- Verify the Playwright execution order: confirm webServers are running before globalSetup executes the fetch, so the guard does not false-positive. If ordering is uncertain, handle the fetch failure safely (treat connection failure as 'could not verify isolation' and abort).

This implements the root-cause guard from the related isolation-hardening idea mqh0su9kgq. The bulk cleanup of already-leaked seed issues is tracked separately under that issue.

This deliverable has NO new user-facing capability — it is infrastructure/test-safety.
